about: The page a person sees after paying (src/checkout-return.mjs): /welcome, headed and worded from the offer they bought (its row's after_purchase: what they got, what they pay, their next step, and the tour `tours_address` opens for it). Buying starts at /buy/<offer id>; when that address carries ?from=<a row's `from`>&return=<the http(s) address of the page they were on>, both are kept on their account for `keep_seconds`, and coming back from checkout opens /welcome with that row's steps under the welcome. A row per place a purchase can start (the Chrome extension today; an iPhone or any other place is one more row). A step's `action.href` is an address, or { "from": "return" } for the page they were on. Pictures live in assets/illustrations/ and are served under /workspace/illustrations/.
title: Welcome to Trillion

welcome.heading: Welcome to Trillion
welcome.body: Your plan is on. Everything Trillion does is open to you now.

origins.body: Your plan is on. Four steps take you back to what you were doing in Chrome.

steps.heading: Go back to the page you were on
steps.body: Press the button below to open the page you were on.

image.alt: A Chrome tab showing the page you were on

action.label: Open the page I was on

steps.heading: Refresh that page
steps.body: Press the round arrow at the top left of Chrome, next to the address. On a Mac you can press Command and R together; on Windows, Ctrl and R.

image.alt: The refresh arrow at the top left of Chrome, circled

steps.heading: Click the Trillion button in your toolbar
steps.body: It is the needle at the top right of Chrome, beside the address. Not there? Click the puzzle piece, then Send to Trillion.

image.alt: The Trillion needle button at the top right of Chrome, circled, with the puzzle piece beside it

steps.heading: Press Save or Send
steps.body: Trillion saves the page or sends it to your AI, just as you were about to.

image.alt: The Send to Trillion window open under the toolbar, with its Send button circled
